item.title: DISTRICT 2 BASKETBALL: Battaglias cherishing final season together on Scranton hardwoods
item.description: There is a gripping excitement as a season enters the playoffs and the pursuit of championships intensifies. item.title: D2 WRESTLING: Leonori eyes memorable last postseason run
item.description: Drew Leonori had a great start to his senior season. item.title: Two residents turn 101 at Linwood Nursing and Rehabilitation Center
item.description: Linwood Nursing and Rehabilitation Center in Scranton celebrated Dorothy Evans, who turned 101 on Feb. 5, and Margaret Marsala, who turned 101 on Feb. 6, surrounded by family and friends. Evans was born and raised in Scranton, and is a retired RN from Mercy Hospital and has six children. item.title: LOCAL COLLEGE: Lackawanna men clinch playoff berth
item.description: Lackawanna College erased an eight-point deficit in the final nine minutes to defeat Essex County College, 93-87, and clinch a NJCAA Region 19 Division II men’s basketball playoff berth. Essex led, 71-63, when Lackawanna went on an 18-2 run to open an 81-73 lead with 3:30 left. The Wolverines got as close as three points with 40 seconds left, but the Falcons hit free throws down the stretch to seal the win. item.title: Former 76ers coach, legendary character Doug Moe dies at 87
item.description: Doug Moe, an ABA original who gained fame over a rumpled, irreverent and sometimes R-rated decade as coach of the Denver Nuggets in the 1980s, died Tuesday. He was 87.
